axis_adapter_keep.contract: Input keep is ignored when disabled (pinned parameter documentation); each accepted input byte and frame boundary preserved on accepted output, legal source held through stall; output valid/payload stable during backpressure.
axis_adapter_keep.excluded: No downsize or arbitrary byte size; no preexisting model candidate is inferred.

axis_fifo_pause.configs: Depth4, RAM_PIPELINE0/1, FRAME_FIFO0, PAUSE_ENABLE1, FRAME_PAUSE1, width8
axis_fifo_pause.contract: Pause between frames; already presented output valid and payload remain stable until handshake except reset. Accepted data/order preserved, reset cancels pending queue. No exact-cycle pause_ack latency claim.
axis_fifo_pause.excluded: Async FIFO touched by same commit is not executed; no extrapolation to async or all depths.

ibex54.configs: Original combinational RV32 compressed decoder, no parameters
ibex54.contract: Pinned PR54/51: compressed HINTs decode as base HINTs, not illegal; independently derive encoding expansions. Reserved high shift bit remains illegal in this historic configuration.
ibex54.excluded: No whole core, no new independent holdout; selected original inputs may repeat old development vectors.

candidate_policy: Handwritten oracle/SVA diagnostics only; no existing generated candidate for these new mechanisms is presumed. Reproduction admission and pilot admission are separate. Stop if qualified editable partial baseline+frontend+meaningful non-whitelist discrimination is not actually established.
